title: Demon Form
description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
smart_description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
notes: This power uses a Counter stack type. At the start of each turn, the player gains Strength equal to the power's current counter value. Each application of this power increments the counter.
